description: Read the graph server-side and return the READING, not the raw material — for a caller that wants an answer rather than 300 facts to page through. Same scope as get_graph (entity + entity_id, or document_ids). Optional: question (a specific one; without it you get a general assessment), focus ('risks' | 'summary' | 'gaps' | 'next_steps'). The contradictions and cross-document links are computed in code and handed to the model as findings, so it interprets them instead of hunting for them; facts from image recognition are marked, so the answer can say when it is standing on one. Costs one model call. Returns the answer plus the counts it was based on, so a thin graph cannot masquerade as a thorough analysis.

concept.description: Only facts whose concept contains this text.

entity.description: Record type whose documents are analysed (e.g. lead, job, contact); use with entity_id

focus.description: Angle of the reading: risks, summary, gaps or next_steps

include_facts.description: Return the underlying facts, not just the summary. Default true.

question.description: Specific question to answer; omitted = general assessment

name: analyze_graph
